framing.text: The card would have shown the exploited route (eid 30320) red for 381 days (1.0 years) before the exploit, from the change that first put it under the floor. At block 24,908,284 it would also have shown 825 of 1,835 comparable OApps (45%) with at least one live route under the floor; this subject ranked #4 by number of such routes. The floor is a broad flag, not a discriminator. By the severity rank — the value at risk behind a route, the larger of the adapter's locked balance on Ethereum and the remote chain's bridged supply, priced with the registry consensus — the exploited route carried $295M (locked on Ethereum). Among the floor-breaching OApps whose value could be priced, this subject ranked #1 of the 8 priced (817 of 825 could not be priced: a token the registry does not price, or a native OFT with nothing locked on Ethereum).
